claims.claim: Infleqtion disclosed on September 24, 2026 that it demonstrated 30 entangled logical qubits on its Sqale quantum computer, directly updating the earlier open milestone question from target to issuer-reported demonstration.

The new disclosure narrows technical milestone uncertainty but does not by itself establish independent verification, fault-tolerant economic advantage, customer workload superiority or scalable commercial unit economics; those remain the relevant falsification boundary for commercialization claims.

factors.name: catalystScore
factors.basis: Issuer-reported 30-entangled-logical-qubit demonstration is a concrete technical milestone.

factors.name: scenarioRobustness
factors.basis: Logical-qubit progress improves the technical path, while commercial robustness still depends on fidelity, scaling, independent validation and customer economics.

factors.name: confidenceInflation
factors.basis: A demonstrated technical milestone should not be promoted into proven economic quantum advantage without workload and customer evidence.

causalEdges.mechanism: larger demonstrated logical systems can reduce one technical uncertainty on the route to useful fault-tolerant workloads
commercial conversion still requires reliable scaling and economic/workload advantage versus classical or alternative quantum approaches

risks.risk: Technical milestone progress can be over-interpreted as commercial validation; independent verification, error/fidelity scaling and customer economics remain necessary before treating the milestone as evidence of durable revenue advantage.

contradictions.claim: Earlier evidence treated 30 logical qubits as a forward target; the September 24 filing reports a demonstration.
contradictions.resolution: Update the milestone status to issuer-reported demonstrated while retaining independent-verification and economic-utility questions as non-gating unknowns.

unknowns.unknown: Independent replication/verification and workload-level economic advantage of the 30-logical-qubit demonstration remain open; lawful evidence path is independent technical validation and customer deployment economics.
